Container.Name: legacy-vault
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted family legacy vault — a searchable library of videos, voice notes, letters and documents to leave for your family. Netflix-style browsing, instant full-text search, in-browser recording, collections, and admin-released legacy items. All media served through authenticated endpoints.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface, plain http (container always listens on 4000).

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Host port for HTTPS (self-signed). In-browser camera/microphone recording requires this address: https://your-ip:8443 — accept the one-time browser warning on each device.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: All videos, audio, files, thumbnails — back this up.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Long random string that signs logins. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 48. Changing it logs everyone out (nothing else is lost).

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The address you open the vault at — used in password-reset links. Update if you switch to Tailscale/HTTPS.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app keeps its data inside the container. Leave as /data.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: debug | info | warn | error. Use debug when diagnosing issues.

Config.Name: EXTRA_TLS_HOSTS
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated extra addresses the vault is reached at (e.g. a Tailscale IP like 100.70.172.63) so the certificate covers them too.

Config.Name: HTTPS_PUBLIC_PORT
Config.Description: The HOST port mapped to 4443 — used when redirecting http visitors to https. Only change if you changed the HTTPS port mapping.

Config.Name: ENABLE_HTTPS
Config.Description: Serve HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (needed for in-browser recording). Set false only if a reverse proxy/Tailscale provides HTTPS.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Optional: SMTP server for password-reset emails. Without SMTP, reset links print to the log.

Config.Name: SMTP_FROM
Config.Description: Optional: From address for reset emails.
